about: NavisLabs launch film — final launch audit (V8 final-audio candidate). Generated by scripts/build-final-audit.py from measurements and validators.

flag_reasons.VOICEOVER_READY: P1–P8 are the founder's files, unchanged (hashes below); every line placed on the measured performance; captions from the measured voice.
flag_reasons.PICTURE_READY: 12 validators pass; frame review and sharpness scan reviewed; dates, names and labels corrected.
flag_reasons.MUSIC_READY: The founder-supplied Eleven Music track is in the film (VERIFIED IN PROVIDED ASSET), but its licence tier is NOT VERIFIED (it depends on the ElevenLabs plan it was generated on — free-tier tracks must credit ElevenMusic), and it needs the founder's listening approval in the final mix.
flag_reasons.SFX_READY: All SFX are in-project synthesized placeholders (TEMPORARY). No ElevenLabs SFX were supplied and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not set, so none were generated.
flag_reasons.DATA_READY: Every visible entity comes from one launch-state file; the customer is a labelled fictional demo organization; all dates validated against Oct 6, 2026.
flag_reasons.INTEGRATIONS_READY: Six live integrations VERIFIED IN CODE (local Navis backend); seven labelled 'upcoming' on screen and in the disclosure (ROADMAP / demo configuration); no action shown executed through them.
flag_reasons.AUDIO_QC: Measured on the master and stems: −14 LUFS, ≤ −1 dBTP, no clipping, no unexpected silence or jumps, voice dominant, A/V in sync.
flag_reasons.VISUAL_QC: 3757/3757 frames, no stray black frames, readable camera moves (sharpness scan + stills), clicks synchronized.
flag_reasons.FINAL_RENDER_READY: False until the founder approves this review, confirms the music licence, and replaces the temporary SFX (or accepts them).

answers.question: Is the founder VO unchanged?
answers.answer: Yes. P1–P8 are the founder's files: same WAVs since V6 (48 kHz, gain-matched; originals kept), no regeneration, no speed or pitch change, no trims inside a chunk, every [pause] kept (≥ 1 s measured).

answers.question: Is every VO section synchronized?
answers.answer: Yes. Each chunk starts at its timeline slot; measured onsets in the rendered voice stem are within 36.6 ms of the timeline; audio vs video length differ by 14.7 ms (AAC padding).

answers.question: Is the music final or temporary?
answers.answer: Final candidate: the founder-supplied Eleven Music track is what plays. It is not yet declared final — licence tier not verified and the founder has not yet approved it in the mix. The V7 in-project score remains only as an automatic fallback (TEMPORARY, never labelled final).

evidence.source: ~/Downloads/ElevenLabs_NavisLabs_Platform_Introduction.mp3 (founder-supplied Eleven Music track, 127.84 s, 44.1 kHz MP3) → scripts/prepare-music-v8.py → 48 kHz WAV
evidence.processing: −1.5 dB headroom (source peaks +0.4 dBTP), 44.1 → 48 kHz, −2.5 dB presence carve at 3 kHz (Q 1.0) for dialogue intelligibility, trimmed to the film's length with a 0.8 s fade; no time-stretch, no pitch change
evidence.status: FINAL CANDIDATE — VERIFIED IN PROVIDED ASSET (founder-supplied ElevenLabs export). Licensing: NOT VERIFIED (depends on the ElevenLabs plan the track was generated on; free-tier tracks require crediting ElevenMusic).

answers.question: Are SFX final or temporary?
answers.answer: Temporary. Every SFX is synthesized in-project (no third-party rights). Replacement plan: scripts/elevenlabs-generate.py --sfx (prompts for every sound) or designed files dropped into public/sfx/final/.

answers.question: What exact music file is being used?
answers.answer: public/music/final/v8/score.wav (48 kHz WAV) made from ~/Downloads/ElevenLabs_NavisLabs_Platform_Introduction.mp3 by scripts/prepare-music-v8.py: −1.5 dB headroom, 44.1 → 48 kHz, −2.5 dB at 3 kHz for dialogue, trimmed to 125.233 s with a 0.8 s fade. Original kept at public/music/source/v8/.

answers.question: What exact SFX files are being used?
answers.answer: 27 files from public/sfx/temp/v7/ (listed in the JSON) plus room tone public/sfx/temp/v8/room.wav; none from public/sfx/final/.

answers.question: Are all visible company names verified?
answers.answer: Yes. NavisLabs is the founder's company (REAL_AUTHORIZED). Kaveri Freightworks is fictional and labelled 'Fictional demo organization' on screen (S05, S07) and in the disclosure. Vendor names (Gmail, Salesforce, Claude Code, …) name connectors/clients nominatively. No real company is shown as a customer; no DailyObjects/Digantara evidence or authorization exists in the repos.

answers.question: Are all people names verified/fictional?
answers.answer: Yes. Abhishek Meena is the founder (REAL_AUTHORIZED, at the founder's request). Meera Iyer, Arjun Rao and Riya are fictional, with reserved example domains. Acme / Jordan Lee / Sam Rivera are gone (validator + project search).

answers.question: Are all dates chronologically correct?
answers.answer: Yes. The film is set on Tue, Oct 6, 2026; past events fall between Sep 30 and Oct 5 (validator dates); the memory card lists them newest first, each dated when it happened; weekdays are correct (Oct 8 is a Thursday).

answers.question: Are future dates clearly represented as future?
answers.answer: Yes. The renewal call reads 'Thu, Oct 8 (upcoming)'; the commitment is 'promised by Oct 7'; the renewal 'closes Nov 14' / 'renews Nov 28'; no November date is phrased as past (validator dates).

answers.question: Are Salesforce/Notion/Microsoft 365/HubSpot/Jira/GitHub/Zoom claims accurate?
answers.answer: Yes. They are labelled 'upcoming' wherever they appear as a Navis source — S04 column 'Upcoming · demo configuration', priority chips, the evidence chips, the across-systems panel, the agent's context table ('salesforce · upcoming'), the run step — and in the end-card disclosure. In S01/S05 they appear only as the company's own tools (where work lives), not as Navis integrations.

answers.question: Are any integrations falsely presented as live?
answers.answer: No. Only the six with backend connectors are under 'Live'; validators check that every evidence row from an upcoming system carries the label and that no screen text says an action was executed through one ('updated in Salesforce', 'synced', 'merged', …). The Salesforce and GitHub rows after the reply say 'Next' with a human/agent owner — no update is claimed.

answers.question: Are any customer claims unsupported?
answers.answer: No. No real customer is named; the disclosure states the organization, people and data are fictional; no metrics, revenue or amounts appear.

answers.question: Are all UI clicks synchronized?
answers.answer: Yes. Every cursor press has its click on the same frame, the cursor settles ≥ 0.1 s before each click, and no click sound plays without a visible click (validator interaction, 29 checks).

answers.question: Are camera movements readable?
answers.answer: Yes. A sharpness scan (with a ±1.5 s window that also catches sustained pushes) was reviewed as stills; fast changes are cuts, eased moves are slow enough to read, S04's pipeline pan runs without blur. Flagged soft moments that remain are fades, dissolves, wipes and sparse frames: 35 listed in navislabs_v8_blur_scan.json.

answers.question: Is the audio mix suitable for a premium startup showcase?
answers.answer: Technically yes, by measurement: the voice leads at ~12.6 LU over the music in speech and ~19 LU under the key lines, the music opens on 'Navis' and rises in the visual-only moments, SFX are felt and below the voice, the room tone keeps the pauses alive at about −50 LUFS. Whether it *feels* premium needs the founder's listening, and the SFX are still temporary.

answers.question: Is dialogue intelligibility good?
answers.answer: By measurement, yes: voice − music 12.64 LU in speech (broadcast guidance ≥ 10 LU), 18.91 LU under the key lines, 13.38 LU on a simulated small speaker; a 3 kHz presence carve in the music; no pumping (music rises 5.7 LU in pauses).

answers.question: Is the final master free of clipping?
answers.answer: Yes: 0 clipped samples, true peak -1.2 dBTP, integrated -14.0 LUFS.

answers.question: Are there black frames?
answers.answer: Only the intended end fade ([[124.97, 125.2]]).
